interpretation: Patterns are locally adapted engineering choices, not reproductions of published performance.

sources.title: GPT6-ARX5 task workflows and experiment records

patterns.idea: Explicit task variants, roles, bounded stages and operation-specific evidence
Task success, human assistance, return and recording coverage are separate outcomes

not_transferred: Historical joint/Cartesian targets, robot parameters, session ownership and physical qualification.
remaining: Generic physical execution of the 18 task contracts, independently matched Piper trials.

sources.title: ManiSkill TurnFaucet-v1

patterns.idea: Bounded episodes, articulated rather than threaded rotation, separate evaluator predicates

not_transferred: Simulator object pose, axis, qpos and reward into RGB controller input.
remaining: ManiSkill adapter with an audited RGB input whitelist; simulation and real faucet trials.

sources.title: Zetta-Embodiment

patterns.idea: Separate diagnosis, bounded recovery proposals and execution authority
Frozen baseline, isolated candidates, independent replay and paired validation before promotion

not_transferred: Automatically generated executable recovery programs or runtime control-code promotion.
remaining: Persistent generic recovery transitions, independent hardware qualification, automated matched-trial candidate selection.

sources.title: Self-Harness: Harnesses That Improve Themselves

patterns.idea: Trace-linked small harness changes, preserved baseline and regression review
Accept optimization only after measured improvement without regression

not_transferred: Software-agent benchmark improvements as physical manipulation evidence.
remaining: Automated development/validation/test partition and promotion tooling; repeated physical performance measurement.

sources.title: Physical RSI 1.0
sources.access_limit: Official project text accessible through search; direct open failed, code/paper version not independently verified.

patterns.idea: Reusable skill composition and episode-specific state; approach, alignment and insertion separated
Time-bounded video evidence linked to task and lifecycle events

not_transferred: Pixel-to-world grounding, stored object poses or automatic historical pose replay.
remaining: Automatic skill learning and recorder service independent of controller exit.

sources.title: RoboICL: Embodied In-Context Learning with GPT-6 Astra

patterns.idea: Bounded, sourced historical context kept distinct from current observations

not_transferred: Demonstration action replay, historical coordinates or old success as current evidence.
remaining: An actual online in-context learning algorithm and transfer benchmarks; generic task model adapter.

sources.title: Code as Policies: Language Model Programs for Embodied Control

patterns.idea: Compose tasks from explicit APIs; local implementation uses strict declarative JSON and registered operations

remaining: Verified execution adapters for newly composed physical skills.

sources.title: Systematically Exploring the Capabilities of GPT-6 Astra as Embodied Policies

patterns.idea: Separate diagnosis, proposed correction and measured effect; distinguish model report from independent outcome
Report elapsed time, model-interface latency, commands and recovery rather than only final success

not_transferred: Cross-platform successes or isolated case improvements as Piper success rate.
remaining: Repeated matched experiments and a generic runner sharing recording and metrics.

common_limits: All new generic recovery/recording tools are offline contracts or metadata review, not physical dispatch.
Current RGB remains the model's visual evidence; no calibration or privileged simulator state added.
Declared labels and file hashes do not authenticate image truth, hardware stops or physical success.
